content_json.title: Use a simple launch offer
content_json.what_it_means: A launch offer should be easy to understand and easy to explain.
what_to_do: Give the first few buyers a small gift-packing add-on.
Make the offer clear in one line.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: First 20 launch orders get free gift packing in {{location}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: A clear offer gives people a reason to order early without making the brand look cheap.
content_json.how_to_check: Check how many people mention the launch offer while messaging.
